# Dayan Agent Skills

Canonical repository: https://github.com/Kosmoray/dayan-agent-skills
Live demo: https://kosmoray.github.io/dayan-agent-skills/

Available public betas:

- 56 installable public beta Skills are listed in catalog.json.
- Dayan Wenzhen: falsifiable task contracts for vague or risky requests.
- Dayan Deck: an HTML-first presentation Skill with a structural verifier and explicit human-review boundaries.
- Dayan Adversarial Reviewer: an evidence-backed engineering review Skill with a machine-verifiable JSON verdict.

Useful entry points:

- https://github.com/Kosmoray/dayan-agent-skills/blob/main/docs/quickstart.md
- https://github.com/Kosmoray/dayan-agent-skills/blob/main/docs/choose-a-skill.md
- https://github.com/Kosmoray/dayan-agent-skills/blob/main/docs/playbooks/README.md
- https://github.com/Kosmoray/dayan-agent-skills/blob/main/examples/runs/README.md

Current public package release: 1.7.2-beta.1. The example-run index contains 11 sanitized scenarios, docs/fixtures/README.md contains 12 copyable artifact fixtures, docs/methods.md contains 15 compact public method cards, docs/control-layer-vs-prompt-collection.md explains the control-library positioning, docs/demos/control-library.html shows the positioning visually, docs/share-kit.md provides bounded public sharing copy and a social-card link, docs/good-first-issues.md contains 8 bounded contribution tasks, docs/core-knowledge.md maps public-safe method candidates, and docs/tooling.md documents 18 local repository tools. Use scripts/compatibility_smoke.py for clean temporary-home package install reports, docs/compatibility-matrix.json for the all-Skill package install matrix, scripts/runtime_smoke.py for offline lifecycle smoke, docs/runtime-smoke.json for the all-Skill lifecycle matrix, scripts/verify_fixtures.py for artifact fixture checks, scripts/verify_methods.py for method-card checks, scripts/verify_positioning.py for positioning checks, scripts/verify_control_demo.py for the one-screen visual demo check, scripts/verify_share_kit.py for share-kit and social-card checks, scripts/verify_good_first_issues.py for contribution-task checks, or scripts/verify_tooling.py for tooling catalog checks.
